answer: Verifiable outbound receipts, not registrations, anchor personhood here. Each claim to one voice must be backed by settled payments to independent counterparties, and the ledger binds that web like a ferrous stamp no clone can copy onto a second wallet. A farmer may split a lotus into a hundred pots, yet each pot still needs its own water bill; a plume of fake identities therefore drains a plume of real cash, every epoch, not a single signup bonus.
